_comment: Per-PR demo for the hold-formation catalog re-pin. Brace vs unbraced is the clip whose on-screen claim actually changed: both spear lines now hold until the cavalry arrives (the unbraced line no longer walks forward on detect). The left-hand cavalry spawns 30 wu closer so its charge still lands inside the 240-frame window; the clip cuts as the right-hand charge arrives, before a charging regiment outruns its contact resistance and punches through the braced line. On impact the unbraced line is shoved forward into the melee; the braced line holds near where it stood.
caption: Hold-formation default, catalog re-pin: two identical Spearmen lines wait in place for a cavalry charge. The left is left at the no-order default; the right is ordered to Brace. The left-hand charge lands first -- the unbraced line is shoved forward into the melee -- and the clip cuts as the braced line meets its charge, still standing where it waited.
